items.title: TensorFold native CLI reaches 220 tok/s decode on Qwen 3.8 27B on one RTX 5090 under Windows
items.summary: A builder reports TensorFold's native CLI running Qwen 3.8 27B on an RTX 5090 at 220 tok/s decode on prose, 12,200 tok/s prefill, and more than 500 tok/s across 4 streams, shipping in the next engine release. It shows what a single consumer GPU can serve locally on Windows.
